input.quote: 12.1.1 Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated in accordance herewith, shall continue in force and effect until (a) the date of expiration of the last Royalty Term for the last Licensed Product, or (b) the expiration of the License Option Period and the failure of AbbVie to exercise the License Option (such period, the "Term").
input.rationale: The Term runs from the Effective Date to a fixed, event-based endpoint (expiry of the last Royalty Term, or lapse of the License Option), with no evergreen or automatic renewal mechanic, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-uplift language anywhere in the document (a search for "renew" returns only an unrelated reference to Regulatory Approval renewals in § 1.40). There is therefore no auto-renewal lock-in for us to exit: the renewal risk the rule addresses is structurally absent, and any extension would require mutual written agreement, which matches the preferred position. Our exit position is in fact better than the playbook baseline because § 12.3 lets AbbVie terminate in its entirety or country-by-country for any or no reason on 90 days' notice. No redline warranted.
